newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.03 down at 41.48 to the dollar on Wednesday on higher demand for the U.S. currency and dealers said the rupee would move in a narrow band in the next few days.
"The rupee dipped slightly because the dollar demand was high today," a dealer said. "In the international market, the U.S currency has also firmed against most of the currencies."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates remained same at 2.60 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
